premise: Duckling wonders what he is good at; nibbling nuts like Squirrel and reaching up tall like Caterpillar don't suit him, until Frog calls him into the pond and he floats.
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling (Andersen), turned: nobody is unkind and nobody has to grow into a swan; he finds his place by finding the water.
lesson: Everyone is good at something of their own.
learning: Ducklings can swim from their very first days

en-US.title: Duckling Finds the Water
en-US.text: {duckling:enter} Little Duckling waddled through the grass, with fluffy yellow feathers, two orange feet and one big question. {duckling:pulse} [curious] What am I good at? {squirrel:enter} Squirrel was sitting nearby with her hazelnut. {squirrel:live} She nibbled it. She looked left and right, hid it behind her back… and gave it a hug. Duckling pecked at an old nutshell. {duckling:face sad} {duckling:wobble} Tock! Too hard for a beak. {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar came crawling by, and Duckling watched her closely. {caterpillar:live} She reared up tall, swayed, and gazed at the sky… then came down with a happy wiggle. Duckling stretched up tall too, {duckling:spin} wibble, wobble… and flopped over. [sighs] Nothing fits, he said. Just then {frog:enter} Frog came hopping to the pond. {frog:face happy} Come and splash! Duckling {duckling:go to pond} waddled to the edge… {sfx:splash solo} In he went! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] He floated! He'd never swum before, but his feet paddled all by themselves. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} [happily] {sfx:quack} Quack! And Squirrel and Caterpillar {squirrel:hearts} {caterpillar:hearts} cheered from the grass.

es-ES.title: Patito encuentra el agua
es-ES.text: {duckling:enter} El pequeño Patito llegó anadeando por la hierba, con sus plumas amarillas y esponjosas, dos patas naranjas y una gran pregunta. {duckling:pulse} [curious] ¿Para qué soy bueno yo? {squirrel:enter} Ardilla estaba sentada cerca, con su avellana. {squirrel:live} La mordisqueó. Miró a un lado y a otro, la escondió detrás de la espalda… y le dio un abrazo. Patito picoteó una cáscara vieja. {duckling:face sad} {duckling:wobble} ¡Toc! Demasiado dura para un pico. {caterpillar:enter} Oruga pasaba reptando, y Patito la observó con atención. {caterpillar:live} Se estiró bien alta, se balanceó y miró al cielo… y luego bajó meneándose, contenta. Patito también se estiró, {duckling:spin} tambaleándose… y se cayó de lado. [sighs] No me sale nada, dijo. Justo entonces {frog:enter} Rana llegó saltando a la charca. {frog:face happy} ¡Ven a chapotear! Patito {duckling:go to pond} anadeó hasta la orilla… {sfx:splash solo} ¡Y adentro! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Flotaba! Nunca había nadado, pero sus patas remaban solas. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} [happily] {sfx:quack} ¡Cuac! Y Ardilla y Oruga {squirrel:hearts} {caterpillar:hearts} lo aplaudieron desde la hierba.
